treatment_summary: The plan addresses dyslipidaemia/NAFLD and the broader metabolic syndrome. A rosuvastatin 10 mg daily is started for cardiovascular risk reduction. Weight loss and glycaemic control are targeted with semaglutide (titrated to 1 mg weekly) and metformin XR (up‑titrated to 1500 mg daily). Dapagliflozin 10 mg daily provides renal and CV protection. Spironolactone 12.5 mg daily is added to treat apparent resistant hypertension, with close monitoring of potassium and renal function. Current antihypertensives are continued. Interactions and contraindications have been reviewed, and monitoring intervals are defined per NICE CG181, NG28, and NG136.
